earnings.title: TE Connectivity delivers 12% sales increase and over 20% EPS growth in fiscal fourth quarter
highlights: Delivered strong full-year performance with sales growth of 15% and more than 20% EPS growth
Net sales were a record $5.3 billion, an increase of 12% on a reported basis and 13% organically year over year, driven by strong growth in both the Industrial and Transportation segments.
GAAP diluted earnings per share (EPS) from continuing operations was $3.10, up 39% year over year.
Adjusted EPS was $3.14, an increase of 21% year over year.
GAAP Operating margin was 21% and adjusted operating margin was 22%, driven by strong operational performance across both segments.

quotes.text: Our teams delivered a strong fourth quarter to finish a year in which we set records in sales, earnings and cash generation.

outlook: For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, the company expects sales of approximately $5.35 billion, up 15% on a reported and organic basis year over year.
GAAP EPS from continuing operations is expected to be approximately $3.04, an increase of 20% year over year, with adjusted EPS of approximately $3.30, up 21% year over year.

items.heading: Conditions in global or regional economies, capital and money markets, and banking systems, and cyclical industry demand may adversely affect our results of operations, financial position, and cash flows.
Foreign currency exchange rates may adversely affect our results.

We have suffered and could continue to suffer business interruptions, including impacts resulting from pandemics, severe weather events, and natural catastrophic events, including those caused or intensified by climate change, and other macroeconomic factors.
We could be adversely affected by a decline in the market value of our pension plans’ investment portfolios or a reduction in returns on plan assets.
Disruption in credit markets and volatility in equity markets may affect our ability to access sufficient funding.
Global political, economic, and military instability could negatively affect sales or profitability.
